passage.text: Many junior high school students in Japan clean their classrooms every day. By doing so, they learn to take care of the places they use. Some students say that a clean classroom helps them study better.

illustrations.caption: 放課後の教室。男子が箒で掃き、女子が黒板を拭き、もう一人の男子が雑巾を持って立っている（吹き出しで窓を拭く姿）。後方に机が3つ積んである。
